definitions.short: Betsalel , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H1212. Betsalel בְּצַלְאֵל proper name, masculine ( in the shadow (protection) of El ; compare cuneiform ‚il-Bêl , a king of Gaza, COT Josh 11:22 ) — 1 a skilled artisan of tribe of Judah Exod 31:2 ; 35:30 ; 36:1-2 , 37:1 ; 38:22 (all P) 1Chr 2:20 ; 2Chr 1:5 . 2 an Israelite Ezra 10:30 .
definitions.rootNote: probably from 6738 and 410 with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God ;

occurrences.englishText: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, Yahweh has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

“Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Yahweh has commanded.”
Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Yahweh had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits,* A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.
Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before Yahweh’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.
Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
